_comment: Copy to ~/.config/whisperrocket/dictionary.json, or load it from Settings > AI > Custom dictionary. 'correct' is the right spelling, 'heard' lists what the recogniser produces instead. confidence 'high' is replaced automatically before the model sees the text; 'low' is only offered to the model as a hint, for cases where context should decide. Matching ignores case and accents and respects word boundaries, so list inflected forms explicitly if you want them corrected.
